title: Leon Thomas & Kehlani Talk R&B’s Future, Wellness & Friendship | Billboard Cover Interview
summary: Leon Thomas sits down with Kehlani for a Billboard Cover Interview to reflect on a friendship that goes back to their teen years — and the creative chemistry that’s kept them connected ever since. Kehlani opens up about the practices that keep her grounded, from the gym and yoga to getting outside, praying and building […]
contentText:
Kehlani
But like I have to do those things. Mm. I have to go to the gym. It is not an option. I have to do yoga. I have to take walks. I have to spend time in nature. I have to build a relationship with God.

Leon Thomas
So first and foremost, how you feeling today?

I’m good. It’s hot.

I know. It’s definitely hot, and I wanna say how- [ laughs ] … proud of you I am. You’ve had such an amazing, an amazing year.

Thank you.

And we’ve been rocking for a long time.

Yeah.

We’ve known each other since we were…

-kids. … Teenagers.

Teenagers.

Yeah. [ laughs ] Yeah, yeah. I remember our first studio session. Mm-hmm. I just saw the picture the other day.

Really? Yeah.

Yeah.We look crazy. [ laughs ]

Absolutely, just fried. But [ laughs ] listen, um, I want you to take me back to teenage Kehlani.

Hmm.

Who were you back then, and what was on repeat at the house?

Teenage me, I was skateboarding, in and out of art school, managing, trying to figure out I’m in this teen band. We’re like traveling all over the place, going from doing shows, driving up here, you know, driving down here to Los Angeles in a van, to back to the Bay, into class, into school.
